aspect_scores.evidence: Many guests praise spotless rooms, but mold in a bathroom and a musty, damp room are serious health-related problems, and one guest found a room not cleaned.
Several guests found the front desk warm and helpful, but others reported an unanswered phone, no action on noise, and slow check-in.
Cinnamon rolls and pastries earned praise, but others reported packaged muffins, few hot options, and the food running out by eight.
Comfortable beds are praised, but guests also reported dated, tired rooms and heaters that rattled or failed on a cold night.
One guest called it great value in season, while another found it disappointing for the price.
Guests praise the walkable, waterfront location near the docks and marina, with no complaints.
Some guests found rooms quiet, but others reported thin walls, hallway sound, late-night neighbors, and a rattling heater.
Both mentions are complaints about limited spaces; one called it a nightmare and the other said it is tight.
Both mentions are complaints: evening drops and slowness for work calls.
Harbor views and the inn's charm are praised, but one guest booked a lakeview room and got a parking lot view.

actions.title: Standardize breakfast with hot options and restock until ten
actions.why: Seven reviews mix praise for cinnamon rolls with complaints of packaged muffins, few hot items, and food running out by eight.

actions.title: Inspect and remediate mold and damp in bathrooms and carpets
actions.why: Reviews report mold in a bathroom and a musty, damp-carpeted room, and cleanliness scores 1 of 5 despite widespread praise for spotless rooms.

actions.title: Service and test every room heater before cold-season stays
actions.why: Guests reported a heater that rattled all night and one that failed on a cold night, and staff could not move the guest to another room.

actions.title: Set up a staffed phone line and a late-night noise protocol
actions.why: Guests reported an unanswered desk phone and no action on noisy neighbors until two in the morning, alongside complaints of thin walls.

actions.title: Upgrade wifi coverage and mark parking limits before arrival
actions.why: Wifi dropped in the evening and was slow for work calls, and both parking mentions called the lot tight or a nightmare.

authenticity.note: Each flag is a signal for review, not a verdict. Confirm keeps its reviews out of the verified rating and the synthesis; dismiss returns them.

flags.rationale: 5 reviews share near duplicate phrasing: peak Jaccard similarity 0.92 (mean 0.79) against a threshold of 0.55.
5 5-star reviews posted within 2 days (2026-06-03 to 2026-06-05); threshold is 3 within 4 days.
2 reviews share near duplicate meaning: peak cosine similarity 0.80 (mean 0.80) against a threshold of 0.80; 1 of 1 pairs in the group were not caught by word overlap.
5 reviews share near duplicate meaning: peak cosine similarity 1.00 (mean 0.99) against a threshold of 0.80; 0 of 10 pairs in the group were not caught by word overlap.
Language resembles reviews written without a stay: p = 0.82 (threshold 0.80). Cues toward deceptive: 'amazing', 'hotel in', 'staff and'; toward truthful: 'michigan', 'in', 'staff'.
Language resembles reviews written without a stay: p = 0.82 (threshold 0.80). Cues toward deceptive: 'amazing', 'hotel in', 'staff and'; toward truthful: 'michigan', 'by', 'in'.

thresholds.duplicate_phrasing: Jaccard word overlap at or above 0.55
thresholds.rating_burst: 3 or more same rating reviews within 4 days
thresholds.claim_duplicate: at least 1 shared specific claim, then a model judgment per pair (lenient prompt)

methods.flag_decisions_by: automatic: every flag confirmed without review (evaluation run)
